sentences.text: Present criminal revision came up for admission on 6.6.2002 and this Court admitted the revision only on the question of sentence.
Court below has awarded one year sentence to revisionist, but there is nothing on record to demonstrate the period of detention already undergone by revisionist or the age of the revisionist.
Apart from above, learned counsel for revisionist is also not present to pursue the present revision.
In view of above, the revision is liable to be dismissed.
Certify this judgement to the lower court immediately.
